theorem star_sum_pair_eq_of_hermitian {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → ι → ℂ)

    star (∑ a ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, f a b) = ∑ a ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, f a b

independent_semantic_findings: For any finite S, star distributes over both sums; the Hermitian hypothesis sends each summand to its transposed pair. Finset.sum_comm restores the original order.

P0 uses the exact full original factor labels. The scalar V*local cutoffMass is real. Its natural totient density is real and symmetric under q/r exchange. Complex gamma and coprime masses are paired with their conjugates, so swapping both full labels after star preserves the entire finite sum.

Self-conjugacy implies ((P0.re):Complex)=P0 by the directly inspected pinned Complex.conj_eq_iff_re. No admissibility, positive modulus, nonzero residue, norm bound or carrier reduction is needed; complex total division covers zero denominators algebraically.

def coprimeMass {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (N : Finset ℕ) (beta : ℕ → R) (q : ℕ) : R
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_definition_source_block:
def coprimeMass {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (N : Finset ℕ) (beta : ℕ → R) (q : ℕ) : R :=
  ∑ n ∈ N, if n.Coprime q then beta n else 0

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: primitiveZeroMain
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_definition_source_block:
def primitiveZeroMain (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ((d.V * CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    ∑ a ∈ d.complexFactorLabels, ∑ b ∈ d.complexFactorLabels,
      d.complexFactorGamma a * star (d.complexFactorGamma b) *
        coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha (complexFactorModulus a) *
          star (coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha (complexFactorModulus b)) *
            (((complexFactorModulus a * complexFactorModulus b).totient : ℂ) /
              (((complexFactorModulus a).totient : ℂ) *
                ((complexFactorModulus b).totient : ℂ) *
                  (complexFactorModulus a * complexFactorModulus b : ℕ)))

/-- Zero-mode discrepancy is exactly the original-alpha covariance,
with each original complex factor fiber retained by an exact identity. -/

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: factor_pair_sum_eq_grouped
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_source_header:
theorem factor_pair_sum_eq_grouped (d : MediumAtom) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ a ∈ d.complexFactorLabels, ∑ b ∈ d.complexFactorLabels,
      d.complexFactorGamma a * star (d.complexFactorGamma b) *
        f (complexFactorModulus a) (complexFactorModulus b)) =
      ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
        d.groupedFactorGamma q * star (d.groupedFactorGamma r) * f q r

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_coprime_uniform_error
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_source_header:
theorem scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_coprime_uniform_error :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ M : ℝ, 0 < M → ∀ S : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ m : ℕ, scaledDyadicCutoff M m ≠ 0 → m ∈ S) →
      ∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ 0 →
      |(∑ m ∈ S, if m.Coprime q then scaledDyadicCutoff M m else 0) -
          (M * cutoffMass) * (q.totient : ℝ) / q| ≤ C * q.divisors.card

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: MediumAtom.transposedAtom
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_definition_source_block:
def MediumAtom.transposedAtom (d : MediumAtom) : MediumAtom :=
  { d with
    U := d.V
    V := d.U
    intervalLo := -1
    intervalHi := (Nat.floor (2 * d.V) : ℝ)
    alpha := d.beta
    beta := fun n ↦ if n ∈ d.alphaCarrier then d.alpha n else 0 }

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: MediumAtom.sum_transposedBeta_mul
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_source_header:
theorem MediumAtom.sum_transposedBeta_mul (d : MediumAtom) (f : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ n ∈ d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier, d.transposedAtom.beta n * f n) =
      ∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n * f n

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: MediumAtom.complexPrincipalRow
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_definition_source_block:
def MediumAtom.complexPrincipalRow (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels,
    d.complexFactorGamma l.1 * d.beta l.2 *
      (if (n * l.2).Coprime (complexFactorModulus l.1) then 1 else 0) /
        (Nat.totient (complexFactorModulus l.1) : ℂ)

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_definition_source_block:
def MediumAtom.complexDispersionU (d : MediumAtom) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ S, w n * ‖d.complexPrincipalRow n‖ ^ 2

/-- The complex cross term uses its real part, with the primitive centre
retained. It is not the product of two real surrogate rows. -/

source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.name: complex_norm_sq_sum_eq_double_star
source_side_primitive_definitions_and_pu.complete_source_header:
theorem complex_norm_sq_sum_eq_double_star {iota : Type*} (S : Finset iota)
    (f : iota → ℂ) :
    ((‖∑ i ∈ S, f i‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ∑ i ∈ S, ∑ j ∈ S, f i * star (f j)

def MediumAtom.physicalFactorModuli (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=
  d.complexFactorLabels.image complexFactorModulus

theorem MediumAtom.sum_factorLabels_eq_grouped (d : MediumAtom) (F : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ r ∈ d.complexFactorLabels, d.complexFactorGamma r * F (complexFactorModulus r)) =
      ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, d.groupedFactorGamma q * F q
